issue: API returns 500 on special characters in query params

observations.detail: Ran npm test — all 15 query-sanitize tests pass: null-byte stripping (literal and %00), path-traversal rejection (forward and back slashes), Unicode/emoji handling (NFC normalisation, mixed scripts), SQL passthrough (by design), and edge cases (undefined, null, non-string, empty string).

This experiment repo has no git remote configured. Cannot push the branch or open a PR via git/GitHub/Azure DevOps. The fix is complete on the local branch fix/special-chars-query-params with 5 commits ahead of master.

Tests use npx tsx directly (no test framework like jest/vitest). The test harness is a hand-rolled async test() + assert() in query-sanitize.test.ts. process.exitCode = 1 on failure ensures CI would catch regressions.

Three prior observation files already exist in .squad/memory/inbox/ from earlier sessions working on this same issue. The fix implementation was already complete — this session confirmed tests pass and the branch is ready for PR once a remote is configured.
